senses.gloss: , (ch. m. (muries) brine, pickle containing fish-hash and sometimes wine.
units: Ab. Zar. 34ᵇ מ׳ אומן מותר you may use muries prepared by a gentile professional cook (because he puts no wine into it).
Ib. ארבא דמורייסא a ship-load of muries.

Pes. 109ᵃ קסתא דמ׳ וכ׳ a xestos measure for muries existed in Sepphoris which corresponded to the Log of the Temple; Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵃ bot.; Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ bot. תומנתא עתיקתא דמ׳ וכ׳ an old Tumanta (eighth of a kab) for muries in Sepphoris.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:1:14">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="R00454"><he>צִירָא</he> I</cite>.
